create_window_instance: create a Window instance with a title to draw a gridworld using Matplotlib
show_observation_image: show an RGB tile observation image with an optional in-game message in the window
set_window_caption: set or update the caption text displayed below the image in the window
register_key_handler: register a keyboard event handler function to respond to key press events
show_window_blocking: show the window and start an event loop with optional blocking mode
